text: Slice 10 plan: ready to go public, when @gitdek chooses. An audit of all 120 commits found no secrets. GitHub stamped 13 merge commits with `joe@puglisij.com`. The plan: @gitdek checks the history for the essay's internal names, turns on email privacy, and makes the repository public. Then branch protection requires `invariant/gate` and a pull request for every change, and outside collaborators' workflow runs need approval. @gitdek ratified it with all four recommendations when the account's Actions minutes ran out. It goes public after slice 9's day-long check. The factory keeps its own proved merge, with GitHub requiring the gate, instead of D-0033's auto-merge. The merge commits with that address, 19 by then, stay as they are, and later merges name the noreply address. Every outside run needs approval.
